title: Space used by the branch union
statement: Let $M_1$ and $M_2$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $b$ be a Boolean, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $t\in\mathbb{N}$. The total space used by the branch union selected by $b$ on its initial configuration with input $x$ through step $t$ is the selected machine's space through step $t$ plus the number of work tapes of the unselected machine: it is $M_1$'s space plus $M_2$'s number of work tapes if $b$ is true, and $M_2$'s space plus $M_1$'s number of work tapes if $b$ is false.
hypotheses_covered: $M_1,M_2$ are finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
